newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: UBK ratcheted up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: UBK ratcheted up in thin trade.

text.p: Shares in UBK bank jumped 6.83 percent in Ljubljana on Monday but traders said poor liquidity diminished the significance of the move.
At 1104 GMT shares in UBK were 390 tolars up at 6,100 on a paltry 100 contracts.
"The move was made in one single transaction," said Nina Jarc, a trader at bank Nova Ljubljanska Banka.
Market participants said the stock may have potential to rise further but noted many investors were reluctant to buy into small banks like UBK.
UBK, which has a market stake of less than 0.9 percent, has said it is mulling a merger with a larger domestic bank in the second half of this year.

"Future direction will depend upon UBK's merger plans. If meger conditions are good for UBK, its shares will grow, otherwise they will fall," said Mateja Gubanec, a broker at bank A banka. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
